title: Catamaran Sailing Cruise in Monterey
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Minimum age requirement for alcohol consumption is 21 years of age
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Enjoy sailing the Monterey Bay without engine noise. You will be offered a complimentary beverage after your captain hoists the sails and catches the wind to make for a peaceful and exciting cruise on the bay.

On the way out of the harbor, look out for sea lions, sea otters, and harbor seals. Once you pass the breakwater, the sailing fun begins and you can relax with a beverage while your captain takes care of you. 

Be sure to be on the look out for whales and dolphins while you sail!

Our spacious and comfortable catamaran is the perfect vehicle for exploring the bay and searching for wildlife!
You have a chance to see sea otter, sea lions, harbor seals, dolphins and whales!
